book.name: 1 KOLINITA
book.title: Kolinita wali Leta Houwan Pol wana Leleli

content: Babala Maisena Bosowaina Totuwalali wana Tuwalali Ana Waisi ge ana Nak Ni Hile
Inoke binimala nuku nuwatuagima ni ola ama Keliso wana totuwalali, bolo i telel wasa toto valila i misumi ana towasa.
He totuwalali bolo ta telel tuwalali etega nihi matahikan, ali logugui bwabwatana heiya wali tonowak wana nuwatu nihi paolaolaek.
Yaa binimala komiu o ebo tologugui no tuwalali ana nak ge ana waisi nuku hile, he nige na nuwanuwatu kaiwena. Bwagana nau totou, nige bosowaina no tuwalali na awa wawaisi-an o ebo na awa nanakan.
He no tuwalali ana nak nige etega ya aatena, yaa nige bosowaina toto ya kaiwena ge ta ba tage nau totuwalali waiwaisana. Babala iya te no tuwalali ana nak ge ana waisi ni hile.

Inoke bahi alomiyau wali tuwalali nuku aawa nanakan o ebo nuku aawa wawaisi-an, kaiwena nigeya ga kot ana sauga i oola. Babala ga ni nem, yaka iya bugul gegewena bolo hi misumi gogouwa alona ge gamagalau ateliya ana nuwatu ni teli tagilagil mwananala. Inoke sauga o kila maisena ge maisena ala tobal Yehoba ni pem ni ola wala tuwalali.
Toekelesiya Bahi Totoliya Alaliya Nihi Teteli Heyan

Taliwau ge nuwau, ewasi no baaba ya ba pwatanem alou ge Apolosa eliyama, kaiwena nuwau na labemiu. Nuwau nuku nuwatuagima, inoke wami pagan alona ge Buki Bwabwalena ana baaba nihi olaolaek, ni ola wala baaba etega, “Ana leleli bahi nuku hehewa likaan.”
Inoke nige bosowaina nuku hanaha ge alomiu etega alana nuku teli heyan ge etega alana nuku teli lowan.

Age alamiu ana bwata gamagalau gegewel alaliya i bwata lake? Age wami waisi etega i gan eliyamiu nige i neneem Yehoba elana? Nigeya! He ebo wami waisi i neem ya te Yehoba elana, ga i ola ge ku hanahanaha?

Age bugul gegewena i olaolaek eliyamiu? Age waisi gegewena iyaka ku kalaopopwi? Age iyaka ku lakema ge ku ola tologugui bwabwatal? He binimala tunahot nuku ola tologugui bwabwatal, inoke tabam ama al ge naha ola tologugui bwabwatal.

Yaa nige i oola. Ana awa eliyau i ola Yehoba ama apostolo i telema mulaa hot. Ama ha ola ya te gamagalau bolo logugui i ba ge nihi yaomal boda mataliyaa. Ama boda gegewel hi gagayawa-agima, aneloseyau ge, panayawi gamagaliliyau ge.

Keliso kaiwena gamagalau hi awa kokokona-agima, yaa age komiu Keliso elana tosiba hot! Ama ha pweyata, yaa age komiu ku gasisi! Ama nige ama awatauwan etega i gagan, yaa age komiu ami awatauwan i bwata!
Valila ge i nem ana siga te lan ebe ha galebu, ha walem, wama galogaloi i nak, hi tagapanapanak-agima, nige wama panuwa hot i gagan,

ge totoma nimama elana ha tuwalali gagasisi inoke ama labe gegewena ha pwawaliya to. Gamagalau hi ba Yehoba ni nuwamutagima, yaa ama ha awaawanun kaiweliya Yehoba ni muloluagil. Gamagalau hi palomwanagima, yaa ama ha papalahikan.

Gamagalau hi ba panapanak-agima, yaa ama baaba waiwaisana elana analiya ha lalahe. Ama ha ola niu kilina toto hi tam yoho, ge ha ola musamusa gamagalau panayawi mataliyaa. Ha olaola ya to ana siga lan ebe.
Baaba bolo ya ya lelelian eliyamiu, bahi nuku nuwatu tage ya babaa papuluwawi-agimiu, yaa ya babaa pahenapu-agimiu i ola komiu natuwau nunuwanil.

I bosowaina na ginol ola kaiwena nau maiseu ya tamamiu. Bwagana Keliso elana ami tomatahikan hi gewi nabi, he nau Keliso elana ya tabwa tamamiu, kaiwena nau heiya te Wasa Waiwaisana ya pwatanim eliyamiu.
Inoke ya ba pagasisi-agimiu, no pagan nuku ahe.

Heiya te kaiwena ge Timoti ya papatuna i nonowa tei. Iya i ola natu nunuwanina, iya Babala wana totuwalali waiwaisana, inoke ni panuwahikagimiu no pagan Keliso elana kaiwena, pagan bolo heiya ya panpankiti-an ekelesiya labi gegewena elal.
Tabam komiu enuna ku nuwatu tage nige na nonowa na kikitemiu, inoke ku hanahanaha.
Yaa sauga kekeisi abwe na nowa, ebo Babala wana nuwatu i ola. Inoke nige tage tohanaha wali baaba ya te na hago ge na atena, yaa wali gasisi na kite.
He Yehoba wana abalogugui nige ta kikiteya gamagalau wali baaba elana, yaa wali gasisi elana.
Hauna nuwamiu? Enibinibi na ahe ge na nowa, o age bosowaina alou ge no nunuwana ge no pagan meimeina na nowa?

footnotes.text: Baaba bolo ya gamagalau saugena o wali baaba etega.
